entry.title: Install InSync on Opensuse
entry.content:
I've been testing insync for several days and I think I'll happily pay for it.

I downloaded two packages, one for the dolphin context menu and another (the fedora one) for the program itself:

20:39 $ rpm -qa | grep insync
insync-1.2.7.35123-fc20.x86_64
insync-dolphin-1.2.7.35123-fc17.noarch

Everything working perfectly on my opensuse

entry.title: Blogging again
entry.content:
After almost a long time inactive (even offline) I have decided that it is time to relaunch this blog for the usual: as a notepad.

I have recovered a sql dump file that I had as a backup (outdated though) and with a small script I have created this blog that now runs on Pelican (abandons Wordpress) and is hosted on github pages.
